title: Function-vector activation MoE without weight experts
hypothesis: On held-out in-context relation queries, a content router over support-extracted residual-stream function vectors will preserve most oracle-routed FV quality, with much smaller actual state than 16 full feed-forward expert copies. A same-router per-task output-bias expert is the cheapest weight-space/native control and must be included to test whether the apparent activation expert is only an ordinary bias update.
physical_object: Pinned frozen EleutherAI/pythia-70m-deduped with one shared residual stream and no task-specific MLP or attention weights.
mirror_coordinate: One support-extracted 512-dimensional residual-stream function vector per relation task; router selects top-1 or composes top-2 vectors from query-context activations.
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen relation behaviors addressed by a content router and represented as residual-stream interventions.

task.relation_tasks: The same 16 fixed relation directions in MA-516 (capital, currency, postal code, element, number, animal sound, French, Spanish and inverses).
task.per_task_split: 16 pairs/task: 8 support examples for FV extraction, 4 disjoint router calibration queries, and 4 disjoint evaluation queries.
task.evaluation: All 16 tasks x 4 audit queries. Score the correct output against the 16 distinct outputs for that relation task by summed teacher-forced log probability.
task.fresh_boundary: New deterministic support/calibration/evaluation split seeds; task facts and model revision stay fixed. Router calibration examples and audit queries are disjoint.

methods: Oracle task-ID explicit FV (quality upper; task ID is charged)
Query-context top-2 softmax-composed FV bank, temperature 0.05
Oracle task-ID per-task residual output-bias expert bank
Same-router per-task residual output-bias expert bank (native weight-space control)
16 independent layer-3 MLP copies, bytes-only structural reference; quality is not inferred

router.feature: Frozen Pythia hidden state at the final Output delimiter for a prompt containing the support pairs and current query input.
router.training: No gradient-trained router. For each task, average and L2-normalize the four router-calibration hidden vectors to form one centroid. Classify by maximum cosine similarity.
router.top2: Softmax of the two largest cosine similarities divided by fixed temperature 0.05; combine their two FV codes.
router.task_id_boundary: Task IDs label calibration examples for centroid grouping and evaluation strata, but are never passed to the routed inference methods.

development.hyperparameter_tuning: None; one intervention layer, alpha=1, top-1 cosine router, top-2 temperature=0.05, fixed prompt template and candidate set.
development.selection_metric: Report every registered method and each relation task; no method selection or alpha sweep.

fresh.opening_rule: Open only if in both development seeds oracle FV improves over no intervention by >=0.05 absolute top-1 accuracy or >=0.15 mean gold log-probability nats, and routed top-1 is within 0.05 accuracy and 0.15 nats of oracle FV. Report the same-router bias control regardless; its expected exact alias is not a reason to alter the gate.

secondary: FV vs output-bias exact behavior equality

storage.authority: Actual uncompressed deterministic NPZ payload bytes plus measured pinned common base files.
paid_objects: full per-task MLP weights for the bytes-only structural reference
pinned model weights, config and tokenizer in full deployment totals
storage.support_examples: Report support examples and extraction compute; they are not inference payload after the vectors are extracted and persisted.

compute.hardware: CPU only, PyTorch five-thread limit, no GPU
compute.inference: Report router MAC proxy (16 x 512 cosine products), one or two 512-d vector additions, candidate forwards and measured per-method wall time.

gates.APPLICATION_SCREEN: Oracle FV clears the no-intervention quality threshold and query-context top-1 routing stays within frozen quality margins in both dev seeds; activation state is reported against the actual 16-copy MLP payload.
gates.FRESH_OPEN: Both dev seeds meet the frozen oracle/routed quality thresholds. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
gates.MIRROR_ATTRIBUTION: A Mirror-specific claim requires a >=0.02 absolute accuracy or >=0.10-nat gold-logprob margin over the same-router per-task output-bias expert at comparable actual bytes. Exact equality is FAIL for Mirror-specific value even if FV interventions help over no intervention.
gates.NUMERICAL_ALIAS_TOLERANCE: Compare activation addition after the Transformer block with a query-position-gated delta to the block MLP output bias. These are algebraically identical in real arithmetic but differ by floating-point addition order; maximum absolute candidate-score difference <=0.01 is considered the expected native alias.
gates.FAIL: Oracle task vectors do not improve the base, the router cannot preserve that gain, or a claimed Mirror-specific benefit is exactly reproduced by the native output-bias expert.
gates.NOT_ESTABLISHED: Pinned artifacts, support/query isolation, or serialized payload verification fails.

boundaries: A fixed 70M model and constrained relation ranking are a mechanism screen, not open-ended language quality.
The relation tasks are fixed prior-art fixtures; fresh seeds vary disjoint example assignments, not the set of semantic relations.
The output-bias expert control is mathematically equivalent to adding the same vector at the same residual-stream site; it tests native attribution, not an independent full-MLP quality upper.
The full MLP expert bank is a bytes-only structural reference, not a trained quality result.
Sixteen task codes do not constitute 16 independent capacities without held-out task quality and retention evidence.

amendments.reason: A read-only pinned-model operator check confirmed that equivalent activation-output and MLP-output bias hooks differ slightly from floating-point addition order.
amendments.change: Define the already intended native-attribution equality as max absolute candidate-score difference <=0.01; no task, model, methods, setting, quality gate, or fresh rule changed.
